newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First, Labour to hold 5.00 p.m. meeting.
newsitem.headline: NZ First, Labour to hold 5.00 p.m. meeting.

text.p: The New Zealand First Party and Labour Party are expected to resume coalition talks with a a meeting beginning around 5.00 p.m. (0400 GMT), a Labour spokesman said.
Sources close to the talks said the parties are working on an executive summary of the final draft coalition document which is likely to be considered by the caucuses of both parties on Tuesday.
A similar document is being prepared from the National Party-NZ First talks which have been going on over the same six week period.
Talks are likely to continue this evening and on Saturday.
